## Invitations

A total of 2333 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 317, representing a rate of 13.6 per cent. The figures indicate that participation was lower than the number of invitations issued. The outreach approach was maintained across the Hill Counties area, with local arrangements adapted where access and travel conditions affected delivery. Staff continued to support attendance by providing clear information and maintaining contact through the available channels. Van days were retained where roads allowed, helping to sustain face-to-face outreach and provide an accessible point of contact for residents.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS, with sms recorded as 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the reminder total was 0. Contact activity therefore relied on the invitation process and in-person outreach arrangements. Van days provided an additional means of engagement where road access permitted. These arrangements were used to support communication with residents and to encourage attendance, while recognising the practical limits imposed by local travel conditions.

Prepared by G. Evans.
